background:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one FIXED empty16:9 battle background for CANCEL CITY Big Bald Energy, ability One Punch One Coupon. Supplied card is ONLY a style reference; no hero or celestial objects.
Scene: exterior FORECOURT of a shabby DISCOUNT SUPERMARKET. Broad unobstructed cracked dark grey asphalt/concrete foreground occupies lower half, level combat plane, waist-height perspective. In distance the full supermarket entrance with grubby glass sliding doors, shopping-cart corral at far left, scuffed low bollards kept against building, blank rectangular poster/sale-sign frames either side of entrance and one blank overhead fascia. All sign spaces completely blank, no writing or numbers. Sparse distant cheap shopping-center architecture; foreground center and left clear for full-body actor and shockwave.
Color/lighting: acid yellow-green supermarket strip lights and sign borders, vivid magenta-pink ambient shadows, icy cyan reflections on glass, deep scratched black ink, dark neutral floor so yellow/red hero will read clearly. Dense harsh black scratched etching, crosshatching, stipple, grungy cheap lurid screenprint texture, exact rough grotesque CANCEL CITY card art. Not clean anime scenery, smooth painting, clean vector,3D or photorealism.
STRICT empty environment: NO human, hero, creature, face, reflection of person, cape, gloves, grocery bag, groceries, coupon, loose paper, cars blocking foreground, explosion, broken flying chunks, shockwave, debris, dust, smoke, particles or baked impact. No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermark, card border. All architecture stable and fixed, all sale signs blank rectangles.
